_help: Edit this file, then restart. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Addresses, the API key, preferred buses and the two timing buffers are easier to set from Settings on the display, which overrides the values here.
_routes_help: Optional. Leave empty to pick routes automatically from your home and work addresses.
_timing_help: Minutes added before the walk (elevator, lobby) and after it (walk into the building, elevator up).
_stops_help: Only stops within this many meters of home/work are considered. Force specific stops with stop_overrides, e.g. {"146": {"home": "1234", "work": "5678"}}; find ids with: python tracker.py --stops
_polling_help: CTA allows 100,000 calls/day per key; each refresh uses about 3. Outside active_hours the display dims and polls slowly.
